caption:
🇫🇷 The rise and fall of revolutionary and Napoleonic France — 1789 → 1816.

France grows in rings 🗺️ First annexations along its own border (Avignon, Savoy, Belgium, the Rhineland), then sister republics and satellite kingdoms, several ruled by Napoleon's relatives, then beaten powers forced into line: Prussia in 1807, Spain in 1808, Austria in 1809. That is why it unravels so fast. The outer rings were held by force, not loyalty: after the Russian disaster of 1812 they switch sides in 1813, and by 1815 France is back near its 1789 borders.

📊 Data: revolutionary and Napoleonic chronology. Each state's status (annexed, vassal, ally, subject) is a year-by-year simplification.
